metadata.title: Retro Pop Rock Album Cover with Outlined Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A tight close-up portrait featuring bold, outlined sans-serif typography that overlaps the subject's hair and clothing.
excludeWhen: text must be placed away from the subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned close-up portrait of a male figure with feathered hair, wearing a red and black striped garment, framed by large-scale outlined sans-serif text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Text overlaps the subject's hair and clothing to create depth
Warm skin tones contrast with the cool dark background
Diagonal lines of the striped collar lead the eye toward the face
Large-scale typography acts as a frame for the central portrait
coreInvariants: Outlined sans-serif typography with transparent or image-filled centers
Tight facial crop focusing on the eyes and expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold outlined text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's eyes, follows the striped collar, and ends at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the dark background to the left of the face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and golden-brown hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark blue background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red stripes on the collar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and skin tones against a low-value, muted background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy outer stroke with a hollow center
Tight kerning with occasional character overlap
Uniform stroke weight for the outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'A' have slightly rounded outer corners to match the stroke weight
The 'S' is tightly curved to fit the compact spacing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different sizes for top and bottom text.

avoid: Solid fills for the large text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and bold presence.
Provides a similar sturdy, classic rock aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight, warm-lit close-up portrait of a person with feathered hair wearing a red and black striped collar against a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, bold, uppercase sans-serif outlined text at the top and bottom, ensuring the outlines overlap the hair and collar.

verificationChecks: Is the text hollow with a visible outline?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?
Is the portrait a tight close-up?
Are the red and black stripes prominent?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red in the stripes
mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific brand logos
Ensure text content is generic or user-provided

avoid: Centered text that obscures the eyes

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is strictly outlined and not solid.
Verify the striped pattern is sharp and high-contrast.
Ensure the hair texture is visible through the hollow parts of the letters.
Confirm the composition feels crowded and energetic, typical of 80s rock art.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-intensity close-up portrait with oversized, hollowed-out geometric sans-serif typography that frames the face.
